zh.title: 延遲不是帳單
zh.question: 延遲降下來，帳單就降下來嗎？並行、快取、少叫一席，各動哪一條軸。

analyst.answer: 更快不等于更便宜。時間和 Token 是兩條軸。
analyst.review: 沒有換算公式。不要寫成一個數。

researcher.answer: 同樣的工作排得更緊，帳單不變。少做一次才變。
researcher.review: 快取命中要單獨記。不能把命中寫成沒有成本。

engineer.answer: 並行把等待疊起來。各席 Token 還是加總。
engineer.review: 八席同時叫會更快，也會更貴。這句要留下。

critic.answer: 把八席同時叫起來會更快，也會更貴。
critic.review: 先選要快還是要省。不要用一個數字交差。

strategist.answer: 先決定要快還是要省。兩個目標不要混成一個數。
strategist.review: 文案裡更快和更便宜必須拆開。

writer.answer: 寫了更快，就不要順便寫更便宜。
writer.review: 讀者只會記住便宜。時間那半句要單獨成句。

quant.answer: 延遲看 P95。帳單看 Token 總量。沒有換算公式。
quant.review: P95 降下來，總量可以不變。這不是矛盾。

chair.answer: 延遲不是帳單。並行只縮短等待。要降帳單，得少叫一席，或少做一次。

en.title: Latency isn't the bill
en.question: If latency drops, does the bill drop? What do parallelism, cache, and skipping a seat each move?

analyst.answer: Faster is not cheaper. Time and tokens are two axes.
analyst.review: There is no conversion. Don't write them as one number.

researcher.answer: Packing the same work tighter does not change the bill.
researcher.review: Count cache hits apart. A hit is not the same as free.

engineer.answer: Parallelism stacks the wait. Seat tokens still add up.
engineer.review: Calling every seat at once is faster and more expensive. Keep that line.

critic.answer: Calling every seat at once is faster and more expensive.
critic.review: Pick speed or savings first. Don't close with one number.

strategist.answer: Decide whether you want speed or savings. Don't blend the goals.
strategist.review: Faster and cheaper must be separate sentences.

writer.answer: If you write faster, don't also write cheaper.
writer.review: Readers remember cheaper. The time half needs its own sentence.

quant.answer: Latency is the P95. The bill is total tokens. No conversion.
quant.review: The P95 can fall while the sum stays. That is not a contradiction.

chair.answer: Latency is not the bill. Parallelism only shortens the wait. The bill drops if you call fewer seats.
